name: EPIC 206069212
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.6 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206069212 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.611071 (16th-84th percentiles 7.494253-7.802704), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206069212: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4694.5566 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206069212 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2554.21875 (16th-84th percentiles 2518.945312-2595.390625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,554 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.84 solar masses and 7.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,695 K at its surface.
